rules.action: Select twelve extra unit records from the same completed window after reading four sentinels
rules.inputs: Current and four preceding sentinel windows; no extra-unit observations or future counts

neural.drive: 1.7*tanh(log1p(sentinel_count)/3) into sixteen fixed neurons per sentinel
neural.features: 64 per-window spike counts and 64 end-window membrane values
neural.learning: Training outcomes fit the decoder only; no label or reward enters the reservoir

rules.normalization: Train-only mean and standard deviation; no test fitting
rules.scope: One short recorded organoid; offline acquisition, no live tissue, causal connectivity, biological learning, general intelligence or consciousness claim
rules.score_ties: Round acquisition scores to nine decimal places, then prefer smaller unit ID
rules.selection: Maximum validation acquired spike entries, then ascending method name and parameter; report all methods

source.attribution: van der Molen et al., Preconfigured neuronal firing sequences in human brain organoids, DANDI 001603 (2026)

rules.target: Unit-specific log1p counts; utility is exact acquired spike entries
